scope: Every ordinary body-flow citation and every bibliography record in the complete canonical publication source was checked. Verification covers the manuscript's historical, contextual, closest-work, formula, software, numerical, and narrow method-comparison claims; it does not claim priority or a literature survey beyond the stated finite result.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage non-interactive audit: freeze each substantive claim/citation pair with a precise source location, then independently verify its exact supporting primary-source passage and record metadata; finally compare ledger, body-flow, bibliography, and resolved-build key sets.
